provenance: А. Игнатьев (перев.). Адбхута-Рамаяна, главы 17-20, 22-23 (рукопись, архив переводчика) -- selected chapters only, not the full work (which runs to 27 chapters). docx -> canonical JSONL via ignatiev_book_to_canonical.py (H1438). Two source quirks preserved rather than corrected: ch.20 v.8 is a genuine near-duplicate couplet in the translator's own manuscript (disambiguated 8/8b, both kept); ch.23 vv.50-53 are printed out of numeric order in the source (50, 52, 51, 53) -- a translator-side list mis-numbering, logged in verse_gaps, not silently reordered.
